items.title: Ripple's Trust Bank Gets Federal Approval
points: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC, the US federal regulator for national banks) granted final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank after 10 months of conditional review.

The bank will manage reserves backing Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin (currently $2.6 billion in circulation) and provide digital asset custody services (secure storage of crypto assets for clients) to businesses.

Sen. Elizabeth Warren called the OCC's crypto charter system illegal, and the Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC this month, arguing these charters bypass traditional banking oversight.
CEO Brad Garlinghouse called the approval a 'revolution' within the traditional banking system.

items.title: Mining Giants Pivot to AI Infrastructure
points: Bitcoin mining firm Luxor Technology raised $16 million to scale its AI compute power business.
NIP Group (parent of esports firm Ninjas in Pyjamas) is tripling its Bitcoin mining commitment, swapping 247 million shares for additional mining machines.
These moves reflect a broader trend of crypto miners leveraging spare hardware to compete in the AI compute rental market (companies like CoreWeave and Nebius rent GPUs to AI labs).

items.title: Solana Ecosystem Developments and Market Sentiment
points: J.P. Morgan Asset Management launched two tokenized money market funds (traditional cash-equivalent funds represented as blockchain tokens) on Solana.
Solana's Alpenglow feature went live, expanding developer tools on the network.
Prediction market odds favor SOL reaching $160 (52%) over dropping to $40 (48%), with SOL trading around $100.
Jump Crypto's Firedancer team now requires users to burn 1 SOL per bug report submission to combat spam from AI-assisted audit contest entries.

items.title: Lightning Labs Wavelength: AI Agents as Bitcoin Recipients
points: Lightning Labs launched Wavelength, letting AI agents send and receive Bitcoin instantly via the Lightning Network (a second-layer payment system that processes Bitcoin transactions faster and cheaper than the main blockchain).
It enables software agents to transact Bitcoin without human intermediaries, including programmatic payments for AI services and millisecond micropayment settlement.

items.title: VanEck's All-in-One Bitcoin ETF Product
points: VanEck introduced an ETF (exchange-traded fund, a security that trades on an exchange and tracks a basket of assets) combining Bitcoin exposure with other diversified assets in one fund.
It targets institutional investors and advisors seeking simplified Bitcoin integration alongside conventional portfolio holdings.
